_meta.adr: ADR-037 modular register fragment — never edit shillinq_register.json
_meta.description: Member 02 of the bookkeeping-waterschappen-bbv-variant chain. Declares the BBVProgramme + BudgetBBVMapping registers and an x-openregister-aggregations block on BBVProgramme that computes TotalBudget (SUM GL-budget × allocation%), YTDSpend (SUM GL.amount where date ≤ today × allocation%), Utilization (YTDSpend / TotalBudget), and ComplianceStatus (unconfigured | on-track ≤75% | at-risk 75–90% | non-compliant >90%) / giant D3. The compliance status is computed at query time, never persisted as a stored column (ADR-031). This member is kind: config; no controller, service, or UI code lands here. Slice 01 (config-schemas-seed) may not yet be on the integrated branch: this fragment is therefore self-contained and re-declares the two registers safely (ADR-037 deep-merge unions schemas by key, so a coincident slice-01 fragment overlays cleanly).

BBVProgramme.title: BBV Programme
BBVProgramme.description: BBV (Besluit Begroting en Verantwoording) programme record for waterschappen: one row per fiscal-year policy programme code (e.g. '2.3.2'). Admin-maintained governance anchor; never hard-deleted, only archived. The compliance status (unconfigured / on-track / at-risk / non-compliant) is COMPUTED at query time by the x-openregister-aggregations.complianceStatus block declared below. It is NEVER stored on this record (ADR-031 / giant D3 /).

programmeCode.description: BBV programme code per BBV-Waterschappen kostentoedeling (e.g. '2.3.2'). Forms a natural key together with fiscalYear + administrationId.
programmeCode.title: Programme Code

description.description: Optional long-form description of the programme's policy scope.
description.title: Description

fiscalYear.description: Fiscal year the programme applies to. Aggregation runs are scoped to (programme.administrationId, programme.fiscalYear).
fiscalYear.title: Fiscal Year

status.description: Programme lifecycle state. Only 'active' programmes participate in compliance dashboards.
status.title: Status

totalBudget.label: Total budget per programme
totalBudget.description: Sum of GL-budget × (allocation% / 100) over every BudgetBBVMapping pointing at this programme. Pure arithmetic: declarative per ADR-031. Carries (TotalBudget(P) = Σ GL-budget × allocation%).
Integer-cent total budget for the programme. Engine MUST evaluate as integer-cent arithmetic to avoid float drift (ADR-031 money rule).

ytdSpend.label: YTD spend per programme
ytdSpend.description: Sum of GL transaction amounts on mapped GL accounts (where postingDate ≤ today AND postingDate ≥ fiscalYear-start) × allocation%, per programme. Pure arithmetic: declarative per ADR-031. Carries (YTDSpend(P) = Σ GL.amount × allocation% per mapping).
Integer-cent year-to-date spend. Engine MUST evaluate as integer-cent arithmetic to avoid float drift (ADR-031 money rule).

utilization.label: Utilization ratio
utilization.description: Ratio of YTD spend to total budget per programme. Pure arithmetic over the two aggregations above. Carries (Utilization(P) = YTDSpend / TotalBudget).
Dimensionless ratio in [0, ∞). Engine MUST compute as cents/cents to retain precision; the ratio itself is allowed to be a float.

complianceStatus.label: Compliance status
complianceStatus.description: Derived enum bucket thresholds. 'unconfigured' if no BudgetBBVMapping exists for the programme; otherwise the threshold against utilization. Computed at query time, NEVER persisted as a stored column (giant D3 / ADR-031).

hasMappings.description: Truthy when at least one BudgetBBVMapping resolves a non-zero allocated budget for this programme.

complianceStatus.description: Carries thresholds: unconfigured | on-track ≤ 75% | at-risk 75–90% | non-compliant > 90%. Boundary semantics (≤ vs <) match the giant: utilization == 0.75 is on-track, utilization == 0.90 is at-risk, utilization > 0.90 is non-compliant.

BudgetBBVMapping.title: Budget BBV Mapping
BudgetBBVMapping.description: Many-to-one mapping from a GL account to a BBVProgramme with an allocation percentage and effective-period guard. Drives both the TotalBudget and YTDSpend aggregations on BBVProgramme.

glAccountNumber.description: GL account number contributing to the programme.
glAccountNumber.title: GL Account Number

glAccountBudgetCents.description: Annual budget on the GL account, in integer cents (Euro precision). The TotalBudget aggregation multiplies this by allocationPercentage / 100.
glAccountBudgetCents.title: GL Account Budget Cents

programmeCode.description: BBV programme code targeted by this mapping. Must match a BBVProgramme.programmeCode in the same administration + fiscalYear.
programmeCode.title: Programme Code

allocationPercentage.description: Share of the GL account's budget + spend allocated to this programme. 100% means the full GL account contributes to this programme; sums across mappings for one (glAccountNumber, fiscalYear, administrationId) MUST not exceed 100% (validated in slice 03).
allocationPercentage.title: Allocation Percentage

fiscalYear.description: Fiscal year the mapping applies to.
fiscalYear.title: Fiscal Year

effectiveFrom.description: First date the mapping is in effect. GL transactions before this date are excluded from YTDSpend.
effectiveFrom.title: Effective From

effectiveTo.description: Last date the mapping is in effect (inclusive). Null means open-ended.
effectiveTo.title: Effective To
